scripts.build:windows: bun run next build && xcopy ".\public" ".\.next\standalone\public" /e /i /y && xcopy ".\.next\static" ".\.next\standalone\.next\static" /e /i /y
scripts.build:linux: rm -rf .next && bun run next build && cp -rf ./public/. ./.next/standalone/public && cp -rf ./.next/static/. ./.next/standalone/.next/static
scripts.start:dev:linux: bun i && bun run build:linux && cd .next/standalone && bun start
scripts.start:dev:windows: bun i && bun run build:windows && cd ".\.next\standalone" && bun start
scripts.copy:release: rm -rf release && mkdir -p release && cp -rf .next/standalone/. release && mkdir -p release/.next/static && cp -rf .next/static/. release/.next/static && mkdir -p release/public && cp -rf public/. release/public && [ -d ./locales ] && cp -rf locales release/locales || echo 'No locales dir' && [ -f ./package.json ] && cp -f package.json release/package.json && [ -f ./bun.lock ] && cp -f bun.lock release/bun.lock && [ -f .env.production ] && cp -f .env.production release/.env || echo 'No .env file' && [ -f ./pm2.config.js ] && cp -f pm2.config.js release/pm2.config.js || echo 'No pm2.config.js file' && [ -f ./docker-compose.release.yml ] && cp -f docker-compose.release.yml release/docker-compose.yml || echo 'No docker-compose.release.yml file' && [ -f ./Dockerfile.release ] && cp -f Dockerfile.release release/Dockerfile || echo 'No Dockerfile.release file' && [ -f ./entrypoint.sh ] && cp -f entrypoint.sh release/entrypoint.sh || echo 'No entrypoint.sh file'
scripts.supabase:types: supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" --schema public > src/lib/types/database.ts
